name: Shake Slate
summary: A step counter drawn on a sketch toy: your walk draws the route, and a good shake clears the day
about: A phone step counter built like a red two-knob sketch toy. As the steps come in, the walk draws itself around a park loop in one continuous line, the knobs spin and the odometer rolls toward the 8,000 goal. Grab the slate and wiggle it side to side (or really shake your phone) and the line crumbles into falling powder, the count rolls down and the day pops into your saved days.
how: Press Walk to start a simulated brisk walk: steps roll up, the route draws itself and the goal ring fills, with a burst when you pass 8,000.
Grab the slate and drag it quickly left and right; every good swing erases a patch. Shake until it is clear and the day is saved as a card.
Changed your mind halfway? Press Undo and the powder settles back into the line.
Drag either gold knob in a circle to doodle: the left one draws across, the right one up and down.
Keyboard: Tab to a knob and use the arrow keys to draw, press S to shake, Enter on Walk to start or pause.
